# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 0.7.1 - 2026-11-04

- First version: Vanta remote MCP server over streamable HTTP.
- Three regional endpoints taken from the vendor's plugin repository (`VantaInc/vanta-mcp-plugin`).
- The auth mode is OAuth, as the vendor describes it. BoldCreate Connect supplies its own OAuth client.
